follow-up time: Until death or discharge from hospital (variable)
exposure: Hemorrhage not affecting the central nervous system
cohort: 77 infants (72 neonates and 5 infants <1 year old) admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of Hospital de Pediatria Juan P. Garrahan between April 2008 and February 2019 who received ECMO
finding: In this cohort of infants receiving ECMO, the presence of central nervous system hemorrhage, hemodiafiltration requirement, inotrope requirement during ECMO, and presence of hemorrhage not affecting the central nervous system were associated with increased mortality on ECMO.
